error.missingDepLong:
Noctalia Deck needs the 'qmltermwidget' package:

  pacman -S qmltermwidget

then restart the shell.
error.schemeDirRO: Noctalia theme: make the scheme dir writable once →  sudo chown "$USER" /usr/lib/qt6/qml/QMLTermWidget/color-schemes

toast.sessionEnded: Terminal session ended — right-click the widget for a new session.

launcher.toggleDesc: Show or hide the Noctalia Deck terminal

settings.positionDesc: Attached drops under the widget that opened it; centered floats centered under the bar.
settings.shellProgramDesc: Leave empty to use $SHELL. Future tiles will run other commands here (e.g. claude).
settings.showToastsDesc: Show a toast when the shell session ends.
settings.themeModeDesc: Match the global Noctalia theme (follows light/dark) or pick a fixed terminal scheme.
settings.schemeDesc: One of the built-in qmltermwidget color schemes.
